exposure: Standardized diagnostic testing and assessment protocol (STORCC initiative)
STORCC color code of perceived risk
outcome: Compliance with second- and third-trimester visits
cohort: Pregnant women (207, resulting in 250 pregnancies) with cardiovascular disease, with a median age of 32 years, were enrolled.
finding: The STORCC protocol for prospective diagnostic testing and follow-up of pregnant women with cardiovascular disease was successfully established, showed high compliance, and its color codes predicted adverse outcomes.
